submitted.rationale: Started from the (Fe,Cr)VO4 region, where V is about 0.5. XRD at 107 and 25 showed the same main phase, with its dominant peak at Q≈2.78. Swapping Fe for Cr at constant V raised the photocurrent from 3.8e-7 A (107) to 6.1e-7 A (25). Following that trend to 68 (Cr 0.375, Fe 0.168, V 0.456) gave 1.14e-6 A, the highest measured.

rejected.reason: Fe-rich (Fe,Cr)VO4 composition; lowest measured photocurrent, 3.8e-7 A
XRD shows a V2O5 secondary phase (Q≈1.095); not prioritised
